items.title: Governor General praises Canada's 'resounding sense of national pride' in New Year's message
items.description: Gov. Gen. Mary Simon praised the 'extraordinary solidarity' she saw in Canada in 2025 in her New Year’s address, pointing to the displays of support in communities hit hard by wildfire, the 'unprecedented economic co-operation' and the revitalization of Indigenous cultures and languages.

items.title: New Ontario fire code rules require carbon monoxide alarms on every floor
items.description: Changes to the Ontario Fire Code coming in the new year will require carbon monoxide alarms on every level of a home in a bid to better protect people from the deadly, odorless gas.

items.title: 8 things to watch for in Alberta politics in 2026
items.description: Duelling citizen-led petitions related to separation, multiple uses of the notwithstanding clause, a slew of recall petitions, progress on a pipeline deal and municipal elections across the province — 2025 was rife with political news. And already, the year ahead is looking to be just as consequential.

items.title: Ontario's new rules for job postings a ‘step in the right direction': experts
items.description: New rules are coming into effect on Jan. 1 in Ontario that will require companies with 25 or more employees to provide compensation details in advertisements for job postings.

items.title: Major water main break in traps people in vehicles, affects 2K Calgary homes
items.description: Early details from City of Calgary indicate 2,000 homes and 100 businesses are impacted by the water main break, which left people trapped in vehicles on Highway 1 as it flooded.
